notes: Robots checked for all eight promoter domains and for the other domains they point to (thetentpole.com, simpletix.com, treasurecoastcardshow.com); none disallows the paths used. The Squarespace sites list AI crawlers in the same group as the wildcard rule, with the same path limits and no blanket block. ultimatebangercardshow.com returns 404 for robots.txt, so it was treated as no restrictions. Not blocked: no page refused access. Several pages returned 404 (Georgia /shows, /schedule, /vendors; Ultimate Banger UltimateCon pages on the Ultimate Banger host and the Kissimmee page). Georgia Collectible Shows has no readable dates on its own site, so no records; Elite Collectibles Expo has an undated March 1 date, so no edition. Past shows recorded only when a size is given: Pokemonster 2026 (450 tables). Past shows skipped without size: Wildwood 2026 editions, Poke-E-Ville Louisville 2025 shows, Morris County Oct 20 2026 PAL, Midwest Monster 2026 editions (not tied to hours or count). Budget: 3 of 6 WebSearch used; 54 WebFetch used of 60. Searches returned third-party listings (cardshopfinder.com, treasurehunter.show); they were used only to corroborate the year for the Duuuval Oct 24 date and are not cited as facts.
